items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: Charles was one of the players at the Playboy Club when I was there and he was doing this date and he had me called in for that date and Bucky was the other guitar player on it.

ctx.x: Did you ever sit in the guitar section with Bucky Pizzarelli?

Only on one date, yeah. And it was for a piano player by the name of Charles Coleman. I don’t know anything about his career anymore. Charles was one of the players at the Playboy Club when I was there and he was doing this date and he had me called in for that date and Bucky was the other guitar player on it.

Well going back to those clarinet etudes you were playing on guitar, your reading must have gotten pretty strong. I’m wondering if you ever found yourself in a situation with a piece of guitar music in front of you going oh my, this is like, I need to woodshed this before I can play it?
